list.description: Give or take a role for many members, by a list of ids

byReaction.description: Give or take a role for everyone who reacted to a message

idsOption.description: Member ids or mentions, separated by commas or spaces

membersOfRoleOption.description: Also take every member who holds this role

roleOption.description: The role to give or take

isRemoveOption.description: Take the role instead of giving it (default: no)

messageLinkOption.description: Link of the message (right-click, Copy Message Link)

emojiOption.description: The emoji to look for; pick one from the suggestions

done: Done: changed the role for {count} member(s).
skipped: {count} id(s) are not members of this server and were left out.
noReactors: No one reacted with that emoji.
noTargets: Give at least one member id, or a role to take the members from.
